title: Could an AFFF exposure review be worth a conversation?
intro: Five quick questions about exposure and health history. No contact details are collected here, and nothing you choose is shared with a firm.
notice: This is a screening conversation starter, not a legal evaluation. Firms decide what they review; DoIHaveAClaim.ai only helps you understand which kind of firm to talk with.

lawyerType.label: Mass tort attorney handling AFFF firefighting foam (PFAS) exposure matters

questions.prompt: How were you exposed to AFFF firefighting foam?
questions.help: AFFF is the foam used to put out fuel fires at fire departments, military bases, airports and industrial sites.

options.label: Civilian or municipal firefighter who used or trained with the foam
Military firefighter or service member who handled the foam
Worked at an airport, refinery, chemical plant or other site that used the foam
Worked where the foam or its PFAS chemicals were made
Lived or worked on or near a base or airport with reported PFAS contamination
Drank water from a supply reported as PFAS-contaminated
None of these, or not sure

questions.prompt: Roughly how long did the exposure last?
Has a doctor diagnosed you with any of the following?

options.label: Another cancer (for example bladder, prostate or pancreatic)

questions.prompt: Have you already signed with a lawyer about this?

disqualify.reason: Firms reviewing AFFF matters look for direct exposure to the foam or to PFAS-contaminated water.

strong.headline: You may potentially qualify for a review by an AFFF exposure attorney.
strong.body: Your answers line up with the screening points firms handling AFFF firefighting foam matters commonly look for. A firm would still need to review your records before deciding anything.

possible.headline: You may potentially qualify, and a few details need a closer look.
possible.body: Some answers match what AFFF firms look for and others need review. Sofia can walk through the details and explain what a firm would want to know.

unlikely.headline: Based on these answers, an AFFF review may not be the right fit.
unlikely.body: That is not a legal decision, and it does not mean nothing can be done. If something changes, or you want to talk through what happened, Sofia is available.
